questions.q: Which clan did Alan most want to avoid in Balquhidder?
choices: The Macgregors
The Maclarens
The Stewarts of Appin
The Athole Stewarts
questions.evidence: Alan, who took up the quarrel of any friend, however distant, was extremely wishful to avoid them

questions.q: Whose household did they find at the first house where Alan knocked?
choices: A household of Maclarens who knew Alan by reputation
A family of Macgregors who were waiting for Robin Oig
An old Campbell shepherd who lived there all alone
A minister and his wife who took in poor travellers
questions.evidence: it was a household of Maclarens that we found

questions.q: How long was David bedridden after the doctor came?
choices: No more than a week
Nearly three months
Only a single short night
Most of the summer
questions.evidence: I lay bedridden for no more than a week

questions.q: Where did Alan stay while David was getting well?
choices: He hid by day in a hole of the braes and visited at night
He went on ahead to Queensferry to wait there for David to come
He slept every night in a bed in the Maclarens' kitchen
He joined Cluny's scouts and kept watch on the soldiers
questions.evidence: He hid by day in a hole of the braes under a little wood

questions.q: What did David see pinned near the foot of his bed?
choices: A printed bill with his portrait and the reward on his life
A letter from Mr. Rankeillor asking him to come to the Lowlands at once
A map of the road south to the Forth that Alan had drawn
A notice calling every man in Balquhidder to join the army
questions.evidence: There was one pinned near the foot of my bed

questions.q: Though many in Balquhidder guessed who David was, he was never questioned or betrayed. What does this show about these clansmen?
choices: They could keep a secret among a whole countryside
They were too frightened of the soldiers to say anything
They had never heard of the murder of the Red Fox
They did not believe a Lowland boy could be wanted
questions.evidence: it is told to a whole countryside, and they will keep it for a century

questions.q: Who came to visit David while he was recovering?
choices: Robin Oig, a son of Rob Roy
Cluny Macpherson, in disguise
James Stewart of the Glens
Mr. Henderland, the catechist
questions.evidence: the visit I had of Robin Oig, one of the sons of the notorious Rob Roy

questions.q: Why were Duncan and David worried when Robin Oig arrived?
choices: Alan was due soon, and the two men were unlikely to agree
Robin had come with soldiers to arrest David for the reward
Duncan owed Robin money and could not pay him what he owed
Robin was known to rob every house he entered in Balquhidder
questions.evidence: the two were little likely to agree

questions.q: Why had Robin come to see David?
choices: A Balfour surgeon had once cured his brother's broken leg
He wanted to collect the blood money set on David's head
He had heard David was a good piper and wished to hear him
He was looking for Alan to settle an old quarrel with swords
questions.evidence: cured my brother's leg when it was broken in the brush at Preston Pans

questions.q: How did Robin treat David once he learned David could not say if he was kin to Balfour of Baith?
choices: Turned away and called him a kinless loon
Laughed kindly and offered him help anyway
Grew angry and threatened to fetch soldiers
Shook his hand and promised to find out
questions.evidence: only some kinless loon that didn't know his own father

questions.q: Why did David almost smile at Robin's insult, even though he was angry?
choices: It was odd for a hunted outlaw to be so fussy about others' family
Robin had mixed up David's name with someone else's by mistake
David knew that his uncle had lied to Robin about the whole family
Robin's Highland way of speaking made the words sound silly
questions.evidence: should be so nice as to the descent of his acquaintances

questions.q: When Alan and Robin met in the doorway they "looked at each other like strange dogs." What does this tell you?
choices: They were suspicious and ready to fight
They were glad to see each other again
They were both very tired and hungry after the road
They did not notice each other at all
questions.evidence: looked at each other like strange dogs

questions.q: What did Duncan do just as the quarrel reached "now or never"?
choices: Stepped between them and proposed a piping contest
Ran outside to call all the neighbours in to help him
Took both their swords and hid them away
Asked his wife to bring in the supper at once
questions.evidence: Here will be a braw chance to settle it

questions.q: What is Athole brose made of?
choices: Old whiskey, strained honey and sweet cream
Oatmeal, cold water and a good pinch of salt
Mutton broth, barley and chopped onions
Hot milk, brandy and a squeeze of lemon
questions.evidence: made of old whiskey, strained honey and sweet cream

questions.q: Alan decorated his playing with grace-notes that pipers call the "warblers." What are the warblers?
choices: Quick notes that ornament a tune
The long low drone notes under a tune
The bags and pipes of the instrument
Slow sad songs played at a funeral
questions.evidence: a perfect flight of grace-notes, such as pipers love, and call the "warblers."

questions.q: How did Alan feel when Robin played his variations back better than he had?
choices: His face grew dark and hot, as if deeply insulted
He laughed and clapped Robin warmly on the back
He was pleased to learn something new about piping
He fell asleep by the peat fire with his bonnet off
questions.evidence: his face grew dark and hot

questions.q: What finally made the last of Alan's anger die away?
choices: Robin played a pibroch that was a favourite of the Appin Stewarts
Duncan poured him a second glass of brose
David got out of bed and begged the two of them to stop fighting
Robin admitted Alan was the better piper
questions.evidence: it was a piece peculiar to the Appin Stewarts and a chief favourite with Alan

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: David recovers among friends, and a quarrel ends in a piping match
David is captured by the Macgregors and must be rescued by Alan and Duncan
Alan and Robin Oig fight a duel with swords, and Robin is badly hurt
David learns at last that he is related to Balfour of Baith
questions.evidence: Thereupon that quarrel was made up
